---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: '[FEATURE] '
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem or workflow this feature would solve:
- **Who**: Which users would benefit (pathologists, residents, QA teams, etc.)
- **What**: What task or workflow would this improve
- **Why**: Why is this feature important

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working:

```bash
# Example usage
claude "Example command using the new feature" < report.txt
```

## Feature Type

- [ ] New skill (e.g., lung-cancer-specialist)
- [ ] New tumor type support
- [ ] Enhancement to existing skill
- [ ] New input format support
- [ ] New output format
- [ ] Language support
- [ ] Batch processing improvement
- [ ] Documentation improvement
- [ ] Other: ___________

## Clinical Guidelines Reference

If this feature relates to clinical guidelines, please provide:
- **Guideline**: [e.g., CAP Lung protocol, AJCC 8th edition]
- **Version**: [e.g., 2024, 8th edition]
- **Link**: [URL to official guideline]

## Alternative Solutions

Describe alternative approaches you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues and feature requests
- [ ] I have provided clinical guideline references (if applicable)
- [ ] I have described the use case clearly
- [ ] I am willing to contribute to this feature (optional)
